description: This file defines the Document class within the OpenCart system, providing methods to manage page metadata such as title, description, keywords, links, styles, scripts, and meta tags.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: A class for managing HTML document metadata including title, description, keywords, links, styles, scripts, and meta tags.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a link element to the document.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds a style sheet link to the document.

methods.name: addScript
methods.description: Adds a script to the document.

methods.name: addMeta
methods.description: Adds a meta tag with specified attributes.
